items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Dalton Smith said, “Don’t you know about this thing called ‘pass it on?’” [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. One of the things you have to learn...

ctx.x: Well at the “Hollywood Palace” it was pretty impressive, I’ll tell ya. “Hollywood Palace” was Manny Klein, Ray Triscari, Sweets Edison and myself. That was one show. And we did the “Tom Jones Show” that was Audino, Ray Triscari, Jimmy Zito and myself. And at both of those shows every time something would come in with some Gs or stuff like that, Manny Klein would go, “Pass that to the kid.” So I used to get all of that because they didn’t want to play it so they’d pass it to me. And then I say like the small band,…

You know I was going to ask you about that passing the part because Bobby Shew had a similar story, that he was complaining about the high parts and Dalton Smith said, “Don’t you know about this thing called ‘pass it on?’”

Yeah. One of the things you have to learn, well you know the funny part is, with Stan Kenton you couldn’t pass. He would not allow the lead — you played lead trumpet you played every single chart. He would not allow passing.
